note: Hand-judged. Each vendored tool in docs/qa/tool-inventory.json is judged exec-routed (matcher includes it, the gate refuses it), exec-residual (conditional on residualCondition) or not-exec. An aliasOf entry is a call-time name absent from the vendored inventory. mcp__* names are matched by the pattern token and judged by the tool-class normalizer, not here. Checked by src/qa/tool-exec-judgment.test.ts; do not run the vendor script over this file.

Runs skill content that can carry shell preprocessing. Conditional on the session being unable to author that content: the skill, command, agent and plugin directories are write-protected. Limit: this does not make installed plugin or marketplace content trusted, and does not cover a directory named through --plugin-dir or a setting pointing outside those roots (not enumerable, unmeasured). Residual #449: nested .claude/skills, commands and agents directories (below a subdirectory or under .claude/worktrees/) are NOT protected (a kernel target is exact or a trailing-/ prefix, no globs); src/qa/tool-exec-judgment.ts findNestedSkillDirs lists existing ones for K activation review (case-insensitive; symlinks and junctions are not followed, a disclosed limit). K's proposal adds glob Edit denies for these directories (Edit(/**/.claude/<dir>/**)); that covers Edit and Write only, and Bash writes there are not kernel-denied by a rule (POL-05 denies non-resolvable binaries), so the residual is the unmeasured glob match plus links.
Same as Skill, for command files; same protected directories and same limits, including the nested-directory residual (#449).
